name: swoltracker
description: AI-powered workout tracking — log sets, track PRs, generate programs, and monitor progress.
author: SnappyClaw

events.name: workout.completed
events.description: A user marked a workout day complete. Payload: { day_name, week_number, total_sets }.

events.name: workout.missed
events.description: A user logged a scheduled workout day as missed. Payload: { day_name, week_number, reason }.

events.name: workout.reminder
events.description: A scheduled workout has no logged sets past the threshold hour. Payload: { day_name, week_number, focus, exercises_count, threshold_hour, triggered_at }.

events.name: max.updated
events.description: A user updated a 1RM record (PR or not). Payload: { exercise, old_max, new_max, is_pr }.

events.name: milestone.hit
events.description: A user achieved a milestone (currently: new PR). Payload: { kind, exercise, old_pr, new_pr, improvement_lbs }.

events.name: program.saved
events.description: A workout program week was saved. Payload: { week_number, gym_id, ai_generated }.
